entry.title: Boris Granular 1.0.1
entry.summary: Rebuilt against the updated mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: **Q-Links now move parameters on track edit → automation** (a plain host write no longer makes MPC rebuild its parameter screen; sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). No other changes. `*-mpc-armv7.zip` is for Gen1 MPCs and the Force; `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` is the Gen2 build (MPC OS 3.x), tested offline only. Settings and your own files in the plugin's data folders are kept on upgrade.

entry.title: Boris Granular 1.0.0
entry.summary: ![Boris Granular on a Force](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sd88me/mpc-vst-boris/2d7b1360c68ccc91b22b0c5030152e08dd3682b8/docs/screenshot-force.png) Real-time granular insert effect for MPC OS / Force: up to 24 grains over a 10 s buffer, tempo sync to MPC, freeze, feedback, per-grain random size / delay / pitch / reverse / volume, 22 factory presets in the PRESET menu, two Q-Link sets and MIDI CC / NRPN control.
